verdict.rationale: Runloop is API-first: Devboxes, blueprints, snapshots, benchmarks, agents, secrets, and mounts are all documented as API/CLI/SDK operations, and the Dashboard is described as a management/monitoring UI layered on top of that same API (runloop-docs-57, runloop-docs-8). This strongly suggests API-UI parity for a developer-tool product, but there is no explicit statement or independent confirmation that literally every dashboard action has an API equivalent (or vice versa), and the OpenAPI spec probe failed, leaving the full surface unverifiable. missing for 10: explicit documentation or independent confirmation of full UI/API parity, a discoverable OpenAPI spec, and any hands-on account of dashboard-only or API-only features.
